La Bonne Poêle is ideal if you want to start with a single versatile size tailored to your household (such as 20 to 24 cm for one or two people, or 26 to 28 cm for a family of four to five). The Pack Brigade gives you three complementary sizes at once, offering excellent value if you want to fully equip your kitchen for different types of daily cooking.

Both options are crafted from 100 percent 3-ply stainless steel, are fully compatible with all cooktops including induction, and come with a lifetime warranty.
